response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT `ReportsTo` AS ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `Employee` GROUP BY `ReportsTo`), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM t) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.ReportsTo, s.cnt AS EmployeeCount, s.share AS Share, s.share - a.avg_share AS ShareDiff FROM s CROSS JOIN a ORDER BY ShareDiff DESC LIMIT 10;
